$comment: Morse Invaders speed ramp and on-screen keyboard (#178), pinned for both
Every expected value below was worked out by hand from the rules in
'derivation', not captured from either port. Do not regenerate it to make
a failing test pass; change it only when the rule is meant to change.

rules: A game starts 'startOffset' WPM under the learner's character speed,
so with characterWpm <= minWpm there is no ramp (start == target).
Farnsworth spacing is ignored: single characters have no gaps to stretch.
Every 'hitsPerStep' hits in total (not consecutive) the speed steps up
'step' WPM, capped at targetWpm. An invader that reaches the ground steps
it down 'step' WPM, never under startWpm. A wrong shot leaves it alone.
bestWpm is the highest speed the ramp reached during the game.

$comment: characterWpm 33: start 23, target 33. 'lives' is raised so four landings
do not end the game. A test drives it with a one-character pool: 'hit'
shoots a live invader, 'escape' lets the lowest one land, 'wrongShot'
names a character nothing carries. 'times' repeats the event; the
expected currentWpm is read after the last repeat. Hit totals in

events.note: [15] hits in total, not in a row

$comment: The hear-it/type-it keyboard is QWERTY: the digit row first when the
pool has any digit, the three letter rows always, and anything else in
the pool (punctuation, prosigns) as a final row in pool order without
repeats. A key outside the pool is still in its row - the screen shows
it dimmed and dead so the layout never shifts as the Koch set grows.

cases.name: a single letter still gets every row
one digit brings the digit row
lower case is upper-cased before matching
punctuation goes in a final row, in pool order
